rows.name: Fire safety
rows.description: Exits, alarms, extinguishers and sprinklers. Based on a typical monthly fire warden walk-through.

rows.name: Food hygiene
rows.description: Storage temperatures, cleaning, pest control and staff hygiene in food preparation areas.

rows.name: Workplace safety walk
rows.description: General hazards: walkways, ladders, electrical equipment, first aid and machine guarding.

rows.question: Are all fire exits clear and unlocked?
rows.guidance: Walk every exit route. Nothing stored in corridors or in front of exit doors.

rows.question: Are exit signs and emergency lights working?
rows.guidance: Press the test button on each emergency light.

rows.question: Are extinguishers in place, charged and inspected within the last 12 months?
rows.guidance: Check the gauge and the inspection tag.

rows.question: Was the fire alarm tested this month?
rows.guidance: Look for the entry in the alarm test log.

rows.question: Is there 45 cm of clearance below sprinkler heads?
Are fridges at or below 5 °C and freezers at or below -18 °C?
rows.guidance: Read the thermometer in each unit, not the display.

rows.question: Is all stored food covered, labelled and in date?
Are hand-wash stations stocked with soap and paper towels?
Is there no sign of pests?
rows.guidance: Check corners, under shelving and the pest control log.

rows.question: Is the cleaning schedule signed off for the last seven days?
Are walkways free of trip hazards and spills?
Are ladders and step stools in good condition?
Are electrical cords and sockets undamaged and not overloaded?
Is the first aid kit complete?
Are machine guards fitted and in use?
